panel.title: HA Notifications
panel.subtitle: Manage alerts, notifications and history.
panel.create_first: Create your first alert. You can trigger it from condition changes, an interval, or both.
panel.admin_help: HA Notifications alerts can only be viewed and edited by Home Assistant administrators.

alert.confirm_test: Test alert "{{name}}"? This sends REAL notifications and runs configured actions, ignoring conditions. Actual trigger data is unavailable.

common.discard_message: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?

visual.invalid_yaml: This YAML must be a valid list to use the Home Assistant visual editor. Switch back to YAML mode to edit it.

basic.name: Name
basic.description_help: An optional note describing this alert and why it exists. It is saved with the alert, not included in notifications sent to recipients.
basic.automation_mode_help: Parallel is usually the best choice for alerts because each trigger can start an independent run. Keep this setting unless you specifically need to ignore, restart, or queue runs.
basic.automation_mode_condition_help: Conditional alerts use Parallel mode so inactive conditions can be monitored without interrupting an active run.

triggers.enable_help: Controls custom triggers and condition-change checks. When off, these settings are preserved but do not start the alert.
triggers.help: Optional. Add event or state triggers as YAML when those events should start the alert. Startup and periodic checks are configured separately. Include each custom trigger as an item in a YAML list; common types include state, event, and template triggers.

conditions.enable_help: Controls condition checks and startup or periodic evaluations. When off, custom triggers can still run without conditions.
conditions.help: Conditions are optional and gate every enabled trigger. When enabled, referenced entities are watched for condition changes. With no conditions, the alert runs whenever another trigger fires. YAML and JSON are supported. For numeric_state, include at least one of above or below. Home Assistant's numeric_state condition does not support for; use a state condition when you need a duration.
conditions.interval_help: Re-check conditions at this interval, even when no relevant entity-change event occurs.

inactive.enable_help: These triggers cancel pending confirmation waits. Disabled settings are preserved.
inactive.clear_notification_help: Also clear the alert notification when an inactive trigger fires.

condition.conditions_help: Enter a Home Assistant condition as a template string, mapping, or list of mappings. YAML and JSON are supported.
condition.numeric_state_help: For numeric_state, include at least one of above or below. Home Assistant's numeric_state condition does not support for; use a state condition when you need a duration.

recipients.help: Search for a recipient, choose a type when needed, then select it. You can mix devices, areas, labels, floors, and notification entities.
recipients.service_help: Selected devices, areas, labels, floors, and notification entities are passed to Home Assistant's standard Notify service.

notification.title: Title
notification.condition_text_help: Add an ID to a condition, then use condition.<id> to show text based on its result.
notification.condition_text_example: {% if condition.front_door %}Door open{% else %}All clear{% endif %}
notification.template_values_help: alert_id, alert_name, alert_active, attempt, trigger, now, and condition.<id>.
notification.ha_templates_help: State helpers work here too, such as states('sensor.temperature'), state_attr('light.kitchen', 'brightness'), and is_state('binary_sensor.door', 'on').
notification.post_send_help: Runs after every notification send. Enter a YAML list of Home Assistant actions. JSON arrays also work because JSON is valid YAML.

mobile.unconfirmed: Recipient platform could not be confirmed.
mobile.no_recipients: No selected recipients were detected for this platform.
mobile.optional_help: Optional notification settings. Disabled values are saved but not sent. Notification delivery and custom YAML fields are unchanged.
mobile.group_help: Groups notifications on Android and iOS. iOS critical notifications cannot be grouped.
mobile.color_help: Hex color such as #03A9F4. On Android, sets the notification accent color, typically used for the small icon or header accents, not the entire notification background. Appearance varies by Android version, device, and theme. On iOS, colors the background of a Material Design sender icon.
mobile.notification_icon_help: Android status-bar icon; iOS sender icon (requires a title).
mobile.icon_url_help: Public image URL or /local/ path. On iOS, overrides the Material Design icon and requires a title.
mobile.channel_help: Android 8+: channel name. Omit to use General. Existing channel settings are controlled on the device.
mobile.importance_help: Sets initial channel importance. Once created, only lowering importance is supported, unless the user has already changed it.
mobile.sticky_help: Android only. Does not prevent swiping away; use Persistent as well.
mobile.persistent_help: Android only; marks the notification as ongoing using this alert's tag. Android 14+ permits individual swipe dismissal while unlocked, but protects it while locked and from Clear all. Enable Sticky too if tapping should not dismiss it. iOS has no equivalent setting.
mobile.alert_once_help: Sound and vibration only on the first notification for a tag.
mobile.vibrationPattern_help: Comma-separated milliseconds: off, on, off, on. Applies when creating the channel.
mobile.ledColor_help: Sets the physical notification LED color on supported Android devices, not the on-screen notification color. Applied when the channel is first created; existing channels retain their device settings.
mobile.subtitle: Subtitle
mobile.interruption-level_help: iOS 15+: passive, active, time-sensitive (can override Focus), or critical (requires critical-alert permission).
mobile.sound_help: Sound name, default, or none. Structured critical sound settings remain available in YAML.
mobile.notification_icon_color_help: Hex color for the Material Design sender icon. Has no effect on an icon image URL.

confirmation.timeout_help: Set how long the confirmation notification stays active on recipients' devices. This does not change the reminder interval or maximum reminders.

reminder.show_attempt_count: Show attempt count in notification title

notification.help: Optionally send a follow-up notification to alert recipients after one recipient confirms the alert. Use {{ confirmed_by }} for the recipient's name. Example: Confirmed by {{ confirmed_by }}.

actions.help: Run these Home Assistant actions after a recipient confirms the alert. Enter a YAML list; JSON arrays also work because JSON is valid YAML.

history.alert_only: Showing events for this alert only.
history.no_matches: No history entries match these filters.
history.activity_help: Notification activity and debug traces will appear here.

yaml.validate_help: Check this YAML configuration without saving it
yaml.reload_help: Reload automations and restore the saved configuration
yaml.description: Advanced editor. Copy this YAML to another system or import a validated configuration into Home Assistant.
yaml.invalid: This YAML is not valid. Fix the highlighted error before saving.
yaml.unsaved: You have unsaved YAML changes. Leave without saving?
